notes: Source = H.R. 755 Engrossed in House (EH), full read (2831 chars); no referencedSources registered on the analysis, so the bill text is the sole source. Zero material issues. Minor flags are all soft likelihoodReason framing (breadth-of-support 'both parties'/'bipartisan backing', forward-looking Senate-odds speculation) plus two minor coverage gaps. Sponsor/cosponsor-count/Senate-calendar facts come from cache metadata (not bill text) and are sanctioned as structural per rubric class 8. featured_quotes[] (Mr. Stauber) was NOT audited: it is a Congressional Record floor quote whose source (congressionalRecord) is not among the provided source files. versionChanges[] was NOT audited: it describes Introduced->Engrossed diffs requiring the Introduced text, which is not among the provided source files.
